==================
RaiseEvent statement
==================

Class C
    Sub DoRaise()
        RaiseEvent Changed(Me, EventArgs.Empty)
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Custom event with handler blocks
==================

Class C
    Custom Event ValueChanged As EventHandler
        AddHandler(value As EventHandler)
        End AddHandler
        RemoveHandler(value As EventHandler)
        End RemoveHandler
        RaiseEvent(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        End RaiseEvent
    End Event
End Class

==================
Custom event with modifier
==================

Class C
    Public Custom Event DataReceived As EventHandler
        AddHandler(value As EventHandler)
        End AddHandler
        RemoveHandler(value As EventHandler)
        End RemoveHandler
        RaiseEvent(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
        End RaiseEvent
    End Event
End Class
